Recommendations are selective and carry no per-chapter quota. Appendices and principles pages are outside this numbered-chapter pass.

Advance parser state until the invalid key appears

Send cancellation; branch on whether service honors it
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Local rejection prevents dispatch; cancellation savings depend on service behavior.

animation_candidates.title: Block Table Indirection and Tail Copy-on-Write
animation_candidates.reason: Reference sharing and a partial-tail append cause an actual allocation and copy, which is hard to infer from a static mapping.
sequence: Resolve a logical token position through its block table
Fork candidates sharing full blocks and a tail
Allocate a private tail for the writing candidate
Copy initialized tail entries, append, and update only that candidate table
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Logical contiguity is independent of physical placement; sharing ends at a private write.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Change append length; inspect used slots, physical block ownership, and tail slack.

animation_candidates.title: Leaf-First Eviction in a Radix Prefix Cache
animation_candidates.reason: An apparently dormant ancestor remains non-evictable until its retained descendants are removed.
sequence: Mark active paths and dormant leaves
Apply eviction pressure
Remove an eligible dormant leaf and release its exclusively held state
Reevaluate the newly exposed parent leaf
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Eviction eligibility follows live references and ancestry, not merely node age.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Activate a request path and apply a block budget; retain reference and eligibility counts.

animation_candidates.title: Monolithic vs. Chunked Prefill

Run the monolithic prefill and hold decode progress
Reset to the same workload
Admit chunks and advance decodes between chunks
Compare first completion and decode gaps on the declared model
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Chunking trades prompt completion delay against decode interruption under shared iteration capacity.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Choose declared chunk size within the source timing model; display omitted overheads and illustrative timing scope.
